cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(PhotospiderIndependentColorOracle LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF)
add_compile_options(-fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
set(PS_COLOR_REFERENCE_DEPS "" CACHE PATH "Pinned extracted source directory")
if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${PS_COLOR_REFERENCE_DEPS}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set PS_COLOR_REFERENCE_DEPS; see ../README.md")
endif()
set(DEPS "${PS_COLOR_REFERENCE_DEPS}")
get_filename_component(REPO "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CMAKE_PROJECT_INCLUDE "")
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(YAML_CPP_BUILD_TESTS OFF)
set(YAML_CPP_BUILD_TOOLS OFF)
set(YAML_CPP_INSTALL OFF)
set(YAML_CPP_FORMAT_SOURCE OFF)
add_subdirectory("${DEPS}/yaml-cpp-0.8.0" yaml EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_TESTS OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_TOOLS OFF)
set(EXPAT_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_DOCS OFF)
set(EXPAT_ENABLE_INSTALL OFF)
add_subdirectory("${DEPS}/libexpat-R_2_7_2/expat" expat EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_library(pystring STATIC "${DEPS}/pystring-1.1.4/pystring.cpp")
target_include_directories(pystring PUBLIC "${DEPS}/pystring-1.1.4")
add_library(pystring::pystring ALIAS pystring)
set(IMATH_INSTALL OFF)
set(IMATH_BUILD_TESTS OFF)
set(IMATH_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF)
set(PYTHON OFF)
set(PYBIND11 OFF)
add_subdirectory("${DEPS}/Imath-3.2.1" imath EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
foreach(feature COMPAT ZLIB BZIP2 LZMA ZSTD LIBCOMP FETCH_LIBS PKCRYPT WZAES OPENSSL LIBBSD ICONV BUILD_TESTS BUILD_UNIT_TESTS BUILD_FUZZ_TESTS)
 set(MZ_${feature} OFF)
endforeach()
add_subdirectory("${DEPS}/minizip-ng-4.0.10" minizip EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set(sse2neon_INCLUDE_DIR "${DEPS}/sse2neon-227cc413fb2d50b2a10073087be96b59d5364aea")
foreach(feature APPS TESTS GPU_TESTS PYTHON DOCS NUKE OPENFX JAVA)
 set(OCIO_BUILD_${feature} OFF)
endforeach()
set(OCIO_INSTALL_EXT_PACKAGES NONE)
set(OCIO_USE_AVX OFF)
set(OCIO_USE_AVX2 OFF)
set(OCIO_USE_AVX512 OFF)
set(OCIO_USE_F16C OFF)
set(_stock_ocio "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/stock-ocio")
execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/prepare_reference.py"
  --source "${DEPS}/OpenColorIO-2.5.2" --output "${_stock_ocio}"
  COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
add_subdirectory("${_stock_ocio}" ocio-build EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
target_include_directories(OpenColorIO PRIVATE "${DEPS}/Imath-3.2.1/src")
file(GLOB LCMS_SOURCES "${DEPS}/Little-CMS-lcms2.19.1/src/*.c")
add_library(stock_lcms STATIC ${LCMS_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(stock_lcms PUBLIC "${DEPS}/Little-CMS-lcms2.19.1/include")
target_compile_definitions(stock_lcms PRIVATE HAVE_GMTIME_R=1 HasTHREADS=1)
target_link_libraries(stock_lcms PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
  target_link_libraries(stock_lcms PRIVATE m)
endif()
add_executable(lcms_reference "${REPO}/oracle/ops/format_color/external/lcms_reference.c")
target_include_directories(lcms_reference PRIVATE "${DEPS}/Little-CMS-lcms2.19.1/src")
target_link_libraries(lcms_reference PRIVATE stock_lcms)
add_executable(ocio_reference "${REPO}/oracle/ops/format_color/external/ocio_reference.cpp")
target_link_libraries(ocio_reference PRIVATE OpenColorIO)



# OCIO resets inherited CXX flags; set numerical flags on the actual targets.
foreach(dependency OpenColorIO yaml-cpp pystring Imath expat minizip-ng)
 if(TARGET ${dependency})
 target_compile_options(${dependency} PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
 endif()
endforeach()
